kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth modify-control-strategy --control-strategy-list Status=2 ApiName=ID_PRO BizType=SUCCESS_RATE_5_MIN Id=38 Threshold=0.9 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --product-type ANT_CLOUD_AUTH --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyControlStrategy

element_fields.help_en: The API name, which is the same as **ProductCode**
element_fields.name: api_name

element_fields.help_en:
The rule configuration type. Valid values:
- **QPS**: QPS greater than
- **SUCCESS_RATE_5_MIN**: success rate in the last 5 minutes less than
- **RESP_TIME_5_MIN**: average response time in the last 5 minutes greater than
- **AMOUNT_RISE**: call volume increase compared to the previous period greater than
- **AMOUNT_FALL**: call volume decrease compared to the previous period less than
- **PASSED_RATE_1_HOUR**: verification consistency rate in the last hour less than
- **PARAM_ERROR_RATE_1_HOUR**: parameter error rate in the last hour greater than
element_fields.help_zh:
规则配置类型：
- **QPS**：QPS大于
- **SUCCESS_RATE_5_MIN**：近5分钟成功率小于
- **RESP_TIME_5_MIN**：近5分钟平均响应时间大于
- **AMOUNT_RISE**：调用量环比增长大于
- **AMOUNT_FALL**：调用量环比降低小于
- **PASSED_RATE_1_HOUR**：近1小时核验一致率小于
- **PARAM_ERROR_RATE_1_HOUR**：近1小时参数错误率大于
element_fields.name: biz_type

element_fields.help_en: The alert threshold of the rule
element_fields.name: threshold

element_fields.help_en:
The status. Valid values:
- **disabled**: Disabled.
- **normal**: Enabled
element_fields.name: status

parameters.help_en: The list of security alert rules
parameters.name: control_strategy_list

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The product type. Currently, only **ANT_CLOUD_AUTH** (financial-grade ID Verification) is supported. All other types have been discontinued
